title: 🚆 Busier Lines, Train Races & Smart Signals (v1.2.0)
message: This update makes every line feel alive. More trains pass you, you can race them side by side, and signals now warn you properly before you have to stop.
points: 🚆 NEW: Busier lines. Passing trains now run on every track, both coming towards you and going your way.
🏁 NEW: Train races. Other trains can run side by side with you, overtake you, or fall behind.
🔀 NEW: Who goes first at the points. When two trains need the same track, one waits. Passenger trains always go first, and locals take turns fairly.
🚦 Better signals. You always see a yellow signal before a red one, so you have time to slow down. Signals are also closer together now.
🛤️ Changing tracks. In Mixed mode the number of tracks changes between stations, from 1 to 4. Your train also uses a different track on each run.
⏱️ Better traffic timing. Light, Normal and Peak traffic now leave a proper gap between trains, and you get a good mix of crossing and overtaking trains.
🚃 Passing local trains are now full 12-car rakes.
🧍 Faster boarding. Passengers get on and off much quicker at every station.
💡 Auto headlight. Your headlight turns on by itself in the evening and off in the morning.
🔧 Trains no longer get stuck or block each other, and waiting trains stop properly at the platform. Plus many bug fixes and smoother driving.

title: 💎 PRO, Secret Offer & Endless Run Results (v1.1.0)
message: This update brings Local Train India PRO, a secret scratch card offer, a proper ending for endless runs and many small improvements.
points: 💎 NEW: Local Train India PRO. Pay once and keep it forever. No ads, and every rake, line and journey option is open.
🎟️ NEW: Secret scratch card. Open the PRO page and scratch the card to reveal a special price. It lasts only 1 hour, so do not miss it!
🏁 NEW: End your endless run anytime. Tap PAUSE, then END RUN to see your total runs, score and distance.
🔔 NEW: Update notices. The game now tells you when a new version is ready and shows what is new.
⭐ Rate the game without leaving it. After a good trip you can give stars right inside the game.
🎉 New sounds and confetti when you unlock the offer or become a PRO member.
🔧 Bug fixes and smoother driving.

title: 🚆 Welcome to Local Train India (v1.0.0)
message: Drive suburban locals across Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Delhi and more.
points: 🚉 Real suburban lines with stations, signals and level crossings
🛠️ Line Studio: build and share your own lines
🌦️ Day, night, monsoon and winter haze driving
